rules.name: EPA FIFRA Antimicrobial / Pesticide Registration Trigger
rules.title: EPA FIFRA Antimicrobial / Pesticide Registration Trigger
rules.expected_requirement: EPA FIFRA Registration Number & Establishment Number required for antimicrobial claims on inanimate surfaces.
rules.explanation: Under 40 CFR § 152.15, products claiming to kill, inhibit, or eliminate microorganisms on inanimate surfaces are classified as pesticides/antimicrobials under FIFRA. Selling without EPA registration causes immediate US customs seizure and marketplace delisting.
rules.fix_suggestion: Remove antimicrobial/germ-killing claims or rephrase to 'cleans surfaces naturally' without pesticidal or pathogen eradication claims.

rules.name: FDA Unapproved New Drug Claim Prohibition
rules.title: FDA Unapproved New Drug Claim Prohibition
rules.expected_requirement: Cosmetic and dietary supplement claims must be restricted to structure/function support, not disease treatment, diagnosis, or cure.
rules.explanation: Claiming to 'cure', 'treat', 'diagnose', or 'prevent' a disease or medical condition legally reclassifies a cosmetic or device into an unapproved new drug or uncleared medical device under the FD&C Act.
rules.fix_suggestion: Replace disease claims with compliant structure/function language: replace 'cures arthritis / eliminates pain' with 'formulated to support joint comfort and soothe tired muscles'.

requirements.name: FDA Drug Approval / Monograph
requirements.description: FDA New Drug Application or OTC Monograph verification.

rules.name: FDA Absolute Ban on Lead Acetate in Hair Dyes
rules.title: FDA Absolute Ban on Lead Acetate in Hair Dyes
rules.expected_requirement: Prohibited color additive. Lead acetate is banned from use in cosmetics in the United States.
rules.explanation: FDA repealed authorization for lead acetate in hair dyes due to data establishing neurotoxic risks.
rules.fix_suggestion: Reformulate hair coloring product to remove lead acetate and utilize FDA-approved color additives.

requirements.name: Lead Acetate Lab Assay
requirements.description: Chemical test confirming zero lead acetate.

rules.name: Federal Prohibition of Mercury and Unapproved Corticosteroids in Cosmetics
rules.title: Federal Prohibition of Mercury and Unapproved Corticosteroids in Cosmetics
rules.expected_requirement: Mercury content must be strictly under 1 ppm; potent corticosteroids are prescription drugs strictly prohibited in cosmetics.
rules.explanation: Cosmetics containing mercury or clobetasol are adulterated under Section 501 of the FD&C Act and trigger immediate import detention.
rules.fix_suggestion: Immediately eliminate mercury compounds and prescription corticosteroid actives from cosmetic formulations.

rules.name: CPSC Prohibition of Small Parts Choking Hazards on Infant Toys
rules.title: CPSC Prohibition of Small Parts Choking Hazards on Infant Toys
rules.directive_code: 16 CFR Part 1501 / CPSIA Small Parts Regulation
rules.statute_citation: 16 CFR Part 1501 / CPSIA Small Parts Regulation
rules.expected_requirement: Toys intended for children under 3 must not have small detachable components that fit into the small parts cylinder.
rules.explanation: Glued plastic button eyes fail CPSC tension tests and present fatal choking hazards to infants under 36 months.
rules.fix_suggestion: Use embroidered eyes or safety-locked molded components passing ASTM F963 pull tests.

requirements.name: Small Parts Test (16 CFR 1501)
requirements.description: CPSC laboratory small parts cylinder test report.

rules.name: Total Lead Content Prohibition in Children's Surface Coatings (>90 ppm)
rules.title: Total Lead Content Prohibition in Children's Surface Coatings (>90 ppm)
rules.expected_requirement: Lead in paint and surface coatings on children's products must not exceed 90 ppm (0.009%).
rules.explanation: Coatings exceeding 90 ppm lead violate CPSIA and constitute banned hazardous substances under the Federal Hazardous Substances Act.
rules.fix_suggestion: Formulate decorative paint with non-toxic lead-free pigments and secure CPSC lab test certification.

requirements.name: Total Lead Paint Analysis
requirements.description: Lead <= 90 ppm tested by CPSC accepted lab.

rules.name: CPSC Prohibition of Children's Toys Containing Banned Phthalates (>0.1%)
rules.title: CPSC Prohibition of Children's Toys Containing Banned Phthalates (>0.1%)
rules.expected_requirement: Children's toys and childcare articles must not contain concentrations >0.1% of 8 prohibited phthalates (DEHP, DBP, BBP, DINP, DIBP, DPENP, DHEXP, DCHP).
rules.explanation: Phthalates are endocrine disruptors prohibited by federal statute in accessible plasticized components of children's toys.
rules.fix_suggestion: Utilize non-phthalate plasticizers such as ATBC, DOTP, or bio-based citric acid esters.

requirements.name: CPSC Phthalate Screening
requirements.description: Verification that 8 restricted phthalates are below 0.1%.

rules.name: Hydrogen Peroxide Direct-to-Consumer Threshold
rules.title: Hydrogen Peroxide Direct-to-Consumer Threshold
rules.expected_requirement: Maximum 14.0% hydrogen peroxide for over-the-counter retail dental whitening without prescription supervision.
rules.explanation: Over 14% hydrogen peroxide presents severe soft-tissue chemical burns and requires professional dental dispensation.
rules.fix_suggestion: Formulate OTC consumer teeth whitening products to <= 14% hydrogen peroxide or equivalent carbamide peroxide.

rules.name: Camphor Concentration Limit for Topical Analgesics
rules.title: Camphor Concentration Limit for Topical Analgesics
rules.expected_requirement: Maximum 11.0% camphor in topical consumer OTC analgesic products.
rules.explanation: FDA regulations cap topical camphor at 11% to prevent systemic neurotoxicity and pediatric seizure risk.
rules.fix_suggestion: Limit camphor active ingredient concentration to <= 11.0% on product packaging and formulation specs.

rules.name: US Customs Mandatory Country of Origin Marking
rules.title: US Customs Mandatory Country of Origin Marking
rules.expected_requirement: Every imported article must be marked in a conspicuous place legibly, indelibly, and permanently indicating the English country of origin (e.g. 'Made in Vietnam').
rules.explanation: Tariff Act Section 304 mandates that all imported merchandise bear indelible country of origin markings to notify the ultimate purchaser in the US.
rules.fix_suggestion: Add permanent 'Made in [Country]' or 'Product of [Country]' marking to product packaging and individual retail unit.

rules.name: Net Quantity Dual Unit Declaration (US Customary & Metric)
rules.title: Net Quantity Dual Unit Declaration (US Customary & Metric)
rules.directive_code: 15 U.S.C. § 1453 / 16 CFR Part 500 (Fair Packaging and Labeling Act)
rules.statute_citation: 15 U.S.C. § 1453 / 16 CFR Part 500 (Fair Packaging and Labeling Act)
rules.expected_requirement: Net quantity statement on principal display panel must express weight or volume in BOTH US Customary units (oz/fl oz/lb) and Metric units (g/ml/kg).
rules.explanation: FPLA mandates dual declaration of net quantity so US consumers can compare unit prices accurately without mental metric conversion.
rules.fix_suggestion: Update net contents label to include dual units, e.g., 'Net Wt. 4.0 oz (113 g)' or '8.0 fl oz (236 ml)'.

requirements.name: Dual Net Quantity Declaration
requirements.description: Dual statement in US Customary & Metric units.

rules.name: Infant Sleep Positioner and Inclined Sleeper Ban
rules.title: Infant Sleep Positioner and Inclined Sleeper Ban
rules.directive_code: 16 CFR Part 1236 / Safe Sleep for Babies Act of 2021 (H.R. 3182)
rules.statute_citation: 16 CFR Part 1236 / Safe Sleep for Babies Act of 2021 (H.R. 3182)
rules.expected_requirement: ABSOLUTE BAN: Infant sleep positioners and inclined sleepers with sleep surface >10 degrees are banned hazardous products under CPSA Section 8.
rules.explanation: Federal law strictly prohibits the manufacture, sale, or distribution of inclined sleep products and crib sleep positioners due to infant positional asphyxiation fatalities.
rules.fix_suggestion: Cease sales immediately and remove product from US marketplace. This product cannot be lawfully marketed for infant sleep in the US.

requirements.name: Banned Product Affirmation
requirements.description: Prohibited under Safe Sleep for Babies Act.

rules.name: CPSC Safety Standard for Infant Walkers (Certification Escalation)
rules.title: CPSC Safety Standard for Infant Walkers (Certification Escalation)
rules.directive_code: 16 CFR Part 1216 / ASTM F977-18 Standard Safety Specification
rules.statute_citation: 16 CFR Part 1216 / ASTM F977-18 Standard Safety Specification
rules.expected_requirement: Children's Product Certificate (CPC) issued by manufacturer/importer based on accredited CPSC laboratory testing to ASTM F977.
rules.explanation: Infant walkers are regulated durable nursery goods requiring stair fall prevention testing, tip resistance, and a formal CPC certificate before CBP import entry.
rules.fix_suggestion: Obtain an accredited ISO 17025 test report for ASTM F977-18 and publish a formal Children's Product Certificate (CPC).

rules.name: Lithium Battery Hazardous Materials Transport Standard
rules.title: Lithium Battery Hazardous Materials Transport Standard
rules.directive_code: 49 CFR § 173.185 / UN Manual of Tests and Criteria Section 38.3
rules.statute_citation: 49 CFR § 173.185 / UN Manual of Tests and Criteria Section 38.3
rules.expected_requirement: UN 38.3 Test Summary (UNTS) document, Class 9 Hazmat shipping labels, and watt-hour rating markings on battery cells.
rules.explanation: DOT PHMSA and FAA strictly govern air and parcel shipping of lithium ion batteries to prevent in-flight thermal runaway and fire events.
rules.fix_suggestion: Secure UN 38.3 battery test summary from battery cell manufacturer and apply lithium battery mark (UN 3481) to shipping boxes.

rules.name: FDA Food Contact Surface Extraction & Resin Safety for Kitchenware
rules.title: FDA Food Contact Surface Extraction & Resin Safety for Kitchenware
rules.expected_requirement: Food contact materials (bamboo, wood finishes, mineral oils) must meet FDA 21 CFR extraction testing for food contact safety.
rules.explanation: Cutting boards and food utensils coated with unapproved resins or toxic finishes adulterate food under Section 402(a)(6) of the FD&C Act.
rules.fix_suggestion: Use food-grade mineral oil, pure beeswax, or FDA-cleared food contact finishes with certified extraction test reports.

rules.name: MoCRA Mandatory Safety Substantiation & US Contact Labeling
rules.title: MoCRA Mandatory Safety Substantiation & US Contact Labeling
rules.directive_code: Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act of 2022 (FD&C Act Chapter VI)
rules.statute_citation: Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act of 2022 (FD&C Act Chapter VI)
rules.expected_requirement: Label must contain a domestic address, domestic phone number, or electronic contact information through which the responsible person can receive adverse event reports.
rules.explanation: MoCRA requires all cosmetic packaging to provide accessible US contact information for mandatory serious adverse event reporting to FDA within 15 business days.
rules.fix_suggestion: Print US contact address, toll-free phone number, or website reporting link on cosmetic outer carton.

requirements.name: MoCRA Adverse Event Contact
requirements.description: Domestic contact info on retail pack.
